subject.title: fix(ci): keep markdown-only PR jobs off Blacksmith

question: Should the early hosted `ci_scope` gate be the CI-routing strategy that lands for Markdown-only PRs after refreshing this branch against current main?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible and proven, but it changes CI runner routing and competes with earlier trigger-level approaches, so maintainer intent should settle the permanent workflow shape.

options.title: Land the scope gate after refresh
options.body: Refresh or merge-check the branch, rerun workflow sanity/exact-head CI, and land the hosted scope gate if it stays clean.

options.title: Choose a different routing shape
options.body: Pause this PR and keep the canonical issue open if maintainers prefer trigger-level filtering or another CI design.

options.title: Defer the optimization
options.body: Leave the current Blacksmith routing in place if the extra hosted gate is not worth the CI graph complexity.

recommendation.title: Land the scope gate after refresh
recommendation.body: Refresh or merge-check the branch, rerun workflow sanity/exact-head CI, and land the hosted scope gate if it stays clean.
